1. Compute the sinogram of the channel with n angles.
2. Apply a 1-D wavelet transform with J levels along each projection.
3. Estimate the noise level of each projection from its finest details.
4. Shrink all detail coefficients of each projection with k times its noise level.
5. Invert the 1-D transforms and rebuild the channel by filtered back projection.
